Summary: The 'Checking SEC ownership filings' state does not show while the ownership lookup is running if any relationship is already admitted (a half-loaded Sysco page reads as complete)
Description: 1) Original intent: DEF-1384 - until the SEC ownership lookup settles (success, failure or the 45-second timeout) the brief and MAP say it is being checked and never read as a final answer. 2) Acceptance criteria: with a resolved entity that has a filer ID, the pending state shows whenever the lookup has not settled, whether or not any relationship is already admitted; the relationships row says 'N admitted ... checking SEC ownership filings for more'; the subject row says it is checking instead of 'No observations bound to X yet'; once settled or timed out the normal text shows; qa_query_corpus covers pending with and without admitted relationships. 3) Current implementation state: useownershiplookup.js defines pending as not settled AND zero admitted relationships; the seeded Restaurant Depot acquisition counts as admitted, so a Sysco run captured before the Vanguard disclosures landed (167 signals, no bound observations) showed '1 admitted . ACQUIRED' and 'No observations bound to SYSCO yet' with no pending text (Founder screenshot 2026-10-09). 4) Dependencies: DEF-1384; KRYL-1389 (the snapshot freeze point supersedes the partial state once built). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none. 6) Maps to current product model: yes. Targeted gate.
